experiment: P5 H4 schedule-ranker source-disjoint OOF v1
status: preregistered after the H4 label dataset passed all integrity gates

scope.tail_H1_H2_H3: excluded from primary predictor because horizon size reveals true EOS

causal_deadline.decision_time: immediately after the first block's offset-0 skeleton observation
causal_deadline.visible_heatmap: 31 frames ending at that offset-0 frame, left padded by the sample's first frame
causal_deadline.visible_decoder_history: at most 16 previously selected oracle-state windows plus the current offset-0 window
causal_deadline.forbidden: all later frames inside the H4 horizon, reference, reward, continuation, remaining length, and true EOS
causal_deadline.interpretation: teacher-forced oracle-state identifiability only, not closed-loop deployment

features.K_history: top-8 probability mass of each visible paid logit hashed to 32 token buckets plus entropy, blank probability, top-1 probability and margin; last/mean/std/last-first pooling; append past schedule counts and previous four offsets
features.summary_U: existing 96-D positive-mass heatmap descriptor over 31 visible frames; concatenate last/mean/std/last-first and fixed signed hash 384->64, seed 261131
features.ordered_U: orthonormal DCT-II coefficients 0..7 along the 31 visible frames for each of 96 descriptors; fixed signed hash 768->256, seed 261132
features.time_shuffled_U: same ordered-U transform after a deterministic per-row permutation of the 31 frames, SHA256 seed namespace p5-h4-u-shuffle-v1

model.type: 81-output closed-form ridge regression with unpenalized intercept
model.target: signed robust value min(center-future reward, late-future reward) for every schedule
model.outer_folds: exact deterministic five source-disjoint robust-oof-v1 folds
model.normalization: mean/std fit on each outer training fold only
model.center_schedule: score fixed to zero at inference
model.selection: argmax score; lexicographic first on ties; center remains available

primary_metrics.signed_robust_reward: sum of the frozen target value at each OOF-selected schedule; diagnostic error-equivalent reward, not WER
primary_metrics.oracle_reward_capture: selected signed robust reward divided by the H4 oracle robust reward
primary_metrics.bootstrap: 10000 source-cluster resamples, seed 261133, reported for KO total reward and KO-minus-K and KO-minus-KX reward

gates.decision: all gates must pass to unlock unknown-EOS equal-budget closed loop; otherwise stop this ordered heatmap-U ranker identity

forbidden: calibration, dev, test, held-out, or closed-loop outcomes
changing features, alpha, folds, candidate selection, seeds, or gates after OOF outcomes
calling signed robust reward WER or claiming deployment from teacher-forced OOF
